name: indahl-source-check
description: Check every citation, reference or link in a paper, report or answer: does it exist, does it say what the text claims, which version was read. Marks each SUPPORTS, PARTIAL, CONTRADICTS, SILENT, NOT_FOUND or CANNOT_TELL. Runs inside your session.
